about_the_game:
LATHOS

A normal day of teaching. An empty lecture hall. Silence that feels alive.

You play as a teacher trapped in an endless loop inside his own classroom searching for answers, solving puzzles, and uncovering fragments of a forgotten past. Every time you fail or miss something, the loop resets. But with each cycle, the truth begins to surface… and it’s darker than you can imagine.

LATHOS is a first-person psychological horror game about guilt, memory, and consequence. Explore a hauntingly realistic university, piece together what happened to the missing students, and confront the horror that refuses to fade.

Key Features:

Atmospheric psychological horror set in a looping world

Puzzle-based progression with evolving environments

Solve logic, math, and memory-based questions twisted into horror challenges

Realistic sound, lighting, and environmental tension

A disturbing truth waiting at the end of the loop

Some lessons can’t be forgotten no matter how many times you start over.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit processor and operating system OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700 or Intel® Arc™ A750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game is expected to run at 1080p/60+ FPS

short_description: A teacher wakes to an empty lecture hall where time stands still. Each loop reveals fragments of truth through questions, memories, and whispers of the past. The only way out is to remember what should have never been forgotten.
